title: Software Development and IT support
description: I currently work at Two Point Zero, a company that provides IT solutions to companies around New Zealand. I worked on developing web tools used internally at the company, using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for the front end and Python for the back end, hosted on an in-house Linux server. I am currently working on migrating legacy code used at the company and developing new software that aligns with the current frameworks. I also provide IT support to clients by setting up and installing hardware.
